metas.name: Breaking Bad
metas.description: A chemistry teacher diagnosed with terminal cancer turns to cooking crystal meth to secure his family's future, descending into the criminal underworld as the ruthless Heisenberg.

metas.name: Better Call Saul
metas.description: The origin story of small-time lawyer Jimmy McGill and his slow transformation into the morally flexible Saul Goodman, set years before Breaking Bad.

metas.name: The Boys
metas.description: A group of vigilantes sets out to expose and take down Vought's corrupt, corporate-controlled superheroes.

metas.name: Gen V
metas.description: Young supes at Godolkin University compete for the best contracts while uncovering dark secrets about Vought's experiments.

metas.name: The Crown
metas.description: The political rivalries and private struggles behind Queen Elizabeth II's reign, from her coronation through decades of royal history.

metas.name: Outlander
metas.description: A WWII nurse is transported back to 1743 Scotland, where she falls for a Highland warrior while fighting to return to her own time.

metas.name: The Blacklist
metas.description: Fugitive mastermind Raymond Reddington surrenders to the FBI, offering to help catch criminals from his 'blacklist' — but only through rookie profiler Liz Keen.

metas.name: The Good Doctor
metas.description: A young surgeon with autism and savant syndrome navigates the challenges of a prestigious hospital's surgical unit.

metas.name: Cobra Kai
metas.description: Decades after the All Valley tournament, Johnny Lawrence reopens the Cobra Kai dojo, reigniting his rivalry with Daniel LaRusso.

metas.name: Seinfeld
metas.description: Comedian Jerry Seinfeld and his eccentric friends navigate the minutiae of everyday life in New York in the definitive 'show about nothing.'

metas.name: The Goldbergs
metas.description: A nostalgic look at the Goldberg family in 1980s Pennsylvania, seen through the camcorder of youngest son Adam.

metas.name: Community
metas.description: A suspended lawyer forms a misfit study group at a community college, leading to wildly inventive genre-bending adventures.

metas.name: The King of Queens
metas.description: Queens delivery driver Doug Heffernan and his wife Carrie's marriage is upended when her eccentric father moves into their basement.

metas.name: Everybody Loves Raymond
metas.description: Sportswriter Ray Barone's suburban family life is constantly intruded upon by his overbearing parents living across the street.

metas.name: The Shield
metas.description: A corrupt but effective anti-gang strike team in Los Angeles blurs the line between justice and criminality.

metas.name: Justified
metas.description: U.S. Marshal Raylan Givens returns to his native Kentucky, where his old-school justice collides with an old friend turned outlaw.

metas.name: Timeless
metas.description: A historian, a soldier, and a scientist chase a thief through history in a stolen time machine, protecting the timeline from being rewritten.

metas.name: The Night Agent
metas.description: A low-level FBI agent manning a night-action phone line is pulled into a deadly conspiracy reaching the White House.

metas.name: Bloodline
metas.description: The return of the black-sheep son threatens to expose the dark secrets of the Rayburns, a respected Florida Keys family.

metas.name: Sneaky Pete
metas.description: A con man released from prison assumes his cellmate's identity, hiding with a bail-bond family while dodging a vengeful gangster.

metas.name: Hunters
metas.description: In 1970s New York, a secret group of Nazi hunters tracks down war criminals hiding in America.

metas.name: S.W.A.T.
metas.description: A S.W.A.T. sergeant torn between his LAPD duties and his roots leads his unit through high-stakes missions in Los Angeles.

metas.name: SEAL Team
metas.description: The professional and personal lives of an elite Navy SEAL team as they train, plan, and execute dangerous missions worldwide.

metas.name: The Wheel of Time
metas.description: Moiraine of the Aes Sedai leads five young villagers on a world-spanning journey, as one may be the prophesied Dragon Reborn.

metas.name: Preacher
metas.description: A Texas preacher merged with a supernatural entity sets out with his ex-girlfriend and an Irish vampire to find God — who has abandoned Heaven.

metas.name: Atypical
metas.description: An 18-year-old on the autism spectrum decides to find love and independence, upending his family's carefully balanced life.

metas.name: Unbelievable
metas.description: Two detectives pursue a serial rapist while a young woman's report is disbelieved — based on a true story and Pulitzer-winning reporting.

metas.name: The Man in the High Castle
metas.description: In an alternate 1962 where the Axis won WWII, resistance fighters discover films showing a different reality.
